{{Lunisolar August}}
'''August 5''' is the 5th day of the month {{ill|August (Lunisolar)|ja|8月 (旧暦)|lt=August (Hazuki)}}, the 8th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}}. Its {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}} day is {{ill|Shakkō|ja|赤口|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11635368}}.
